_comment: Converted from StormATC data/flightchecklists/c172-preflight.json (Cessna 172 Preflight). Verification steps keep their challenge and note rather than a guessed simvar check.

items.note: Verify ignition off, seats/belts secured, circuit breakers in.
Check fuel quantity, quality, vents, and filler caps.
Check horizontal stabilizer, elevator, rudder, trim tab, tie-down removed.
Check aileron, flap, wing tie-down, pitot tube, fuel tank, fuel sump.
Check propeller, cowling, oil level, landing light, nose wheel tire.
Check pitot tube removal, fuel tank, fuel sump, wing tie-down, flap, aileron.
